linearRefusals.LINEAR_NOT_CONNECTED: Linear is not connected to this organization. Connect it from the integrations page first.
linearRefusals.LINEAR_NEEDS_RECONNECT: The connection with Linear has expired or was removed. Reconnect your Linear workspace from the integrations page.
linearRefusals.LINEAR_WORKSPACE_TAKEN: This Linear workspace is already connected to another organization. Disconnect it there first, or use a different workspace.
linearRefusals.LINEAR_NO_TEAM: No Linear team is set for this project. Choose a team in the project's issue settings.
linearRefusals.LINEAR_TEAM_NOT_FOUND: This Linear team no longer exists or is not accessible. Choose another team in the project's issue settings.
linearRefusals.LINEAR_ISSUE_NOT_FOUND: This Linear ticket could not be found. Check the identifier or the link, then try again.
